character_types: waiter in waistcoat and bow tie
visual_synopsis: Outside a stone-clad upscale restaurant a group of men in suits, led by a heavyset one in a yellow turtleneck, argue and jostle with a young waiter in a striped waistcoat and bow tie. A liveried taxi pulls into the driveway, the waiter pleads and makes phone calls while the car comes and goes, and the sketch ends with the whole group crammed into the back seat of the one taxi, a sneakered foot pressed against the window.
